title: Reinforcement Learning based DBMS Buffer Pool Auto-Tuning for Optimal Memory Utilization
abstract: arXiv:2608.11239v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Administering Database Management Systems (DBMS) instances requires Database Administrators (DBA) to balance performance in terms of Service Level Agreement (SLA) against resource usage, often prompting RAM over-allocation that wastes memory. We introduce MicroTune, an online RL-based buffer adjustment system that minimizes unnecessary memory allocation while ensuring SLA compliance. To identify the most effective RL core, we evaluate multiple algorithms under diverse benchmark workloads, training MicroTune on extensive traces of both external metrics (latency, throughput) and internal DBMS metrics (status variables and performance statistics). Experimental results demonstrate that MicroTune dynamically adapts buffer sizes to workload fluctuations, outperforming baselines by achieving significant memory savings with fewer SLA violations. These findings underscore the promise of reinforcement learning for adaptive resource management in

translated_title: 基于强化学习的数据库管理系统缓冲池自动调优以实现最优内存利用
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11239v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：管理数据库管理系统（DBMS）实例需要数据库管理员（DBA）在服务级别协议（SLA）方面平衡性能与资源使用，这通常导致过度分配RAM而浪费内存。我们引入了MicroTune，一种基于在线强化学习的缓冲区调整系统，旨在最小化不必要的内存分配，同时确保SLA合规性。为了识别最有效的强化学习核心，我们在多种基准工作负载下评估了多个算法，使用外部指标（延迟、吞吐量）和内部DBMS指标（状态变量和性能统计）的大量轨迹训练MicroTune。实验结果表明，MicroTune能动态调整缓冲区大小以适应工作负载波动，在显著节省内存的同时减少SLA违规，优于基线方法。这些发现强调了强化学习在自适应资源管理中的潜力。
tldr: 本文提出MicroTune，一种基于强化学习的在线缓冲池调优系统，通过动态调整DBMS缓冲区大小，在保证SLA合规的同时显著节省内存，优于传统基线方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MicroTune, an online RL-based buffer pool tuning system that dynamically adjusts DBMS buffer sizes to achieve significant memory savings while ensuring SLA compliance, outperforming baselines.
